exercises.why: **изучил** — изучи́ть (perfective): to learn, to study; to research, to explore. Wiktionary: из- + учи́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to teach (often not in an academic setting)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: научи́ть — to teach (often not in an academic setting); учи́лище — specialized school, college; изуче́ние — studying (of a particular subject), exploration; изучи́ть — to learn, to study.
**выучил** — вы́учить (perfective): to learn (to completion, typically something involving rote memorisation); to memorize. Wiktionary: вы́- + учи́ть.
